public_display_requirements: Show the legal answer separately from property-specific evidence.
Show applicable date and last-verified date.
Show what the evidence establishes and does not establish.
Never imply live retrieval when no retrieval event exists.
Route individual-property questions through the evidence gate.
integration_test_requirements: General property-title question resolves to verified general information.
Property-specific question without official evidence remains evidence-pending.
Official record route selection remains separate from legal conclusion.
Historical questions retain historical legal context.
